title: Bodhi Pakshika Dharma Retreat 3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating awareness and balance in the body through mindfulness practices, such as paying attention to the physical position of the head during zazen. By doing so, one can develop a deeper understanding of oneself and the world, leading to greater freedom and acceptance. This approach is also linked to the concept of "four proper exertions," which involves cultivating wholesome mental powers and making intentional choices that shape one's future, all while maintaining a soft and open mindset that allows for clarity and discernment.
